applicable_sections: section 7 BlockingCommit and local state authority
section 8 Draft/intent boundary and typed bindings
section 9 VEC, time, boundary, and generation-unit invariants

root_cause: The former A5 implementation was a v2.0 consumer of removed GenerationSegmentTimeline and GenerationSegment types. It allowed model-authored duration weights, inferred reference and dialogue bindings from fact-ID prefixes and narrative text, and modeled a whole scene as one bounded segment. Those mechanisms contradict the frozen v3.0 contract where Drafts carry only creative choices and local deterministic code owns IDs, hashes, per-shot time, boundaries, binding resolution, and VEC assembly.

alternatives_considered.option: Restore v2 GenerationSegment or GenerationSegmentTimeline aliases.
alternatives_considered.reason: Aliases would create a second time/domain authority and reintroduce scene-wide generation semantics prohibited by v3.0.

alternatives_considered.option: Keep duration_weight as a compatibility input and translate it locally.
alternatives_considered.reason: It preserves a model-controlled numeric timing surface instead of the frozen DurationIntent plus GenerationCapabilityProfile authority.

alternatives_considered.option: Automatically bind every fact or infer bindings from fact IDs or descriptive text.
alternatives_considered.reason: A fact registry is provenance, not an execution binding instruction. Only explicit typed intents with approved opaque handles may create a reference or audio requirement.

alternatives_considered.option: Limit every Scene to the 15-second generator maximum.
alternatives_considered.reason: The v3.0 cap belongs to each GenerationUnit/shot; SceneTimeline must be able to place multiple adjacent units beyond that cap.

repair: Replaced the duration-weight allocator with DurationIntent-to-GenerationCapabilityProfile mapping. Each local GenerationUnit starts at tick zero, observes its own capability maximum, and receives one deterministic adjacent SceneTimeline placement.

Replaced the former segment-based VEC assembler with a v3.0-only assembler. It creates opaque local IDs, input and structural output digests, one GenerationUnit per shot, local VisualBeat intervals, N+1 scene boundaries, and local state chains.

Resolved references only from ReferenceBindingIntent and dialogue only from DialogueBindingIntent. Both paths require an exact approved opaque fact handle; reference responsibility is checked against typed fact semantic, and dialogue uses only typed dialogue qualifiers.
Derived dialogue markers solely from the local target VisualBeat interval and PlacementPhase. Source provenance never participates in timing.
Kept BlockingCommit as local B0 authority, rebased its default schema marker to the canonical v3.0 domain version, and rejected an IdFactory program-version mismatch before assembly.

Removed the old A5 acceptance surface and replaced it with v3.0 invariants covering deterministic rebuilds, structural output hashes, per-shot caps, multi-unit scene duration, explicit VisualBeats, typed bindings, no automatic requirements, fail-closed semantic/handle errors, and absence of legacy inference paths.

checks.name: drafts_contain_creative_choices_only
checks.evidence: A5 accepts ExecutionDesignDraft/BlockingDraft fields only; duration selection is the DurationIntent enum and final IDs, ticks, placements, requirements, and boundaries are all created locally.

checks.name: local_ids_hashes_and_ticks
checks.evidence: IdFactory produces all VEC entity IDs, the assembler calculates canonical input and structural output SHA-256 values, and tests recompute the output digest excluding only its self-reference.

checks.name: local_binding_and_boundary_assembly
checks.evidence: The assembler resolves typed handles through FactRegistry and creates scene entrance, every cut, and scene exit boundaries locally with deterministic state linkage.

checks.name: explicit_visual_beats
checks.evidence: Every ShotDesignDraft visual beat becomes a non-empty adjacent local VisualBeat interval that covers exactly its GenerationUnit timeline.

checks.name: deterministic_vec_rebuild
checks.evidence: Two assemblies from identical approved inputs compare equal, including local IDs, timelines, graph fields, and canonical hashes.

checks.name: typed_reference_binding
checks.evidence: ReferenceRequirement is emitted only for a typed ReferenceBindingIntent whose opaque handle resolves exactly and whose FactSemantic is compatible with its responsibility.

checks.name: typed_dialogue_audio_binding
checks.evidence: AudioEvent and one matching VoiceRequirement are emitted only for DialogueBindingIntent resolving a typed DIALOGUE fact with typed speaker and spoken-text qualifiers.

checks.name: no_fact_id_or_statement_parsing
checks.evidence: A5 static acceptance inspection rejects any assembler fact-ID prefix or statement access; resolution uses FactRegistry.by_handle and FactSemantic/FactQualifiers only.

checks.name: per_shot_generation_cap
checks.evidence: GenerationUnitTimeline receives target ticks from GenerationCapabilityProfile and enforces its own max_generation_ticks.

checks.name: scene_duration_not_capped_at_15s
checks.evidence: Two extended units deterministically form a 624000-tick SceneTimeline while each remains under the 360000-tick per-unit capability cap.

checks.name: dialogue_phase_tick_placement
checks.evidence: OPENING/EARLY/MIDDLE/LATE/CLOSING map deterministically inside the target VisualBeat; the MIDDLE test proves the resulting marker.

checks.name: source_span_never_used_as_timing
checks.evidence: Changing only dialogue provenance positions leaves the local dialogue marker unchanged; static acceptance rejects source-span member access in the assembler.

checks.name: requirements_bound_to_shot_or_beat
checks.evidence: References resolve to the declared shot or declared beat, while audio and voice requirements resolve to one declared shot and one declared beat with bidirectional VEC back-references.

checks.name: free_text_intents_not_bound
checks.evidence: With no typed binding intents, a populated FactRegistry creates zero reference, audio, or voice requirements; retired free-text audio/reference draft fields do not exist.

informational_results.name: a0_a5_registered_regression
informational_results.summary: 86 passed in 5.96s across A0 release control, A1 domain, A2 persistent graph, A3 knowledge flow, A4 provider, and A5 VEC assembly.

informational_results.name: a5_static_legacy_and_patch_check
informational_results.summary: A5 service sources contain no removed segment imports, duration_weight allocation, fact-ID prefix inference, statement parsing, or source-span timing access; git diff --check passed.

authority_boundary.model_authority: Draft and intent only; deterministic local code owns IDs, hashes, time, placements, boundaries, resolved bindings, GenerationUnits, and the VEC.
authority_boundary.binding_authority: Only typed ReferenceBindingIntent and DialogueBindingIntent with exact approved opaque handles establish requirements. Free text and unbound facts never establish a binding.
authority_boundary.time_authority: GenerationCapabilityProfile maps DurationIntent to per-unit ticks. SceneTimeline is a local placement graph and never applies a scene-wide generator cap.

non_goals: No ProjectionAST, delivery adapter, media, A6, A7, A8, A9, or A10 work was started.
No v4 production path, production switch, external runtime, or external media invocation was modified or enabled.
No user-owned pre-existing worktree change outside the A5 allowed paths was modified or staged.
